svg.text: find control plane by tag Name
aws s3 cp chart · helm lint
anime-review-app builds and tests → GitLab registry → anime-review-k8s pins the tag in Helm values
→ chart shipped through S3 → AWS SSM runs helm upgrade on the private control plane
Tag = short commit SHA, identical for
